_comment: Input to L1-design-integration-architect, DELTA INVOCATION (BOM Phase 4). Per the BOM row: 00-overview.md's cross-component sequence, openapi.yaml from design-api-spec, and the current integration-architecture.md. This invocation also merges the cycle's cross-component sequence into INT-4 as a canonical flow — an end-to-end sequence crossing several services is an integration flow, and no single component HLD can hold it.
_bom_gap: 00-overview.md is an input here and is committed by L1-github-orchestrator, but no Phase 4 agent row names the agent that AUTHORS it — and the BOM describes it as 'the only original content in the package'. This example takes it as assembled from the HLD and LLD deltas by design-hld, and flags the unassigned ownership rather than assuming it.

sections_relevant.INT-2: Approved styles: synchronous request/response via the group gateway; asynchronous domain event; asynchronous evidence event; outbound one-way feed; read-only time-scoped evidence access. Not approved: direct database access, shared mutable tables, undocumented point-to-point calls, file exchange as a permanent style.
sections_relevant.INT-3.1: {context}.{entity}.{event}, lowercase, dot-separated, past tense. The context segment is a bounded context name.
sections_relevant.INT-3.2: Event kinds: Lifecycle, Evidence, Movement, Notification. identity.registration.verified is Evidence — strict per-producer ordering, ES3 retention, never replayed.
sections_relevant.INT-4: 6 registered flows, INT-4.1 through INT-4.6, covering all 6 APP-2.3 edges
sections_relevant.INT-5: 6 contracts, all owned by a HarvestLink bounded context, all Planned
sections_relevant.INT-7: Trust boundaries: producers/buyers/distributors on the external IdP; certification body read-only time-scoped; group DW outbound-only; SMDS read-only check
sections_relevant.INT-11: INT-C1 every cross-context edge has a contract; INT-C2 no cross-context DB grants; INT-C3 synchronous calls are budgeted
sections_relevant.INT-12: INT-PEND-01 partner file exchange, INT-PEND-02 notification latency budget, INT-PEND-03 certification-body evidence API

foundational_architecture_ref.note: No edge exists from Identity to any competent-authority register. An edge added to APP-2.3 is a change to the FSA's component interaction map, which is what makes a delta structural.
foundational_architecture_ref.structural_rule: Structural deltas propagate to foundational-solution-architecture.md and require an ADR plus Enterprise Architect approval. Additive and extending deltas touch component documents only. That asymmetry is what keeps the target stable enough to conform against.

fdp_overview_input.cross_component_sequence:
```text
producer -> external IdP            : authenticate
producer -> producer-portal         : submit registration
producer-portal -> identity-service : POST /v1/producers/registrations
identity-service -> identity_schema : append pending-verification
identity-service --> producer-portal: 201 Created

[out of band]
identity-service -> COMPETENT-AUTHORITY FBO REGISTER : lookup(fbo_number)
                    ^^^^ crosses the product boundary — no APP-2.3 edge exists
identity-service -> identity_schema : append outcome (supersedes)
identity-service -> event broker    : identity.registration.verified
event broker -> notifications-worker: consume
notifications-worker -> producer    : outcome email
```

content.execution_summary: • 3 operations, all inbound to identity-service. None describes the outbound register call — an outbound dependency on a contract this product does not own has no place in this product's OpenAPI document.

upstream_findings.summary: The outbound FBO register call is a new egress path with no PLT-6 capability behind it.
The 'no assume-valid branch' rule has no test that can prove the absence of the branch.
